note: ADR-017/021/024/026/034/035/070: exact inherited dependency hashes and reviewed static catalogue provenance/user-clicked URI data plus authorized offline research endpoints. The sole runtime image exception is the independently reviewed, SHA-256-pinned native favicon collector explicitly requested by the user. ADR-070 additionally permits only the exact editable manual proxy diagnostic default URL in proxy-ui.js; loading/connecting/status never performs that probe. Other runtime network references remain forbidden. ADR-076 additionally authorizes a separately hash-pinned opt-in fixed Cloudflare GET API connector; ADR-109 additionally authorizes the separately hash-pinned opt-in geolocation lookup client proxy-geo-client.js (fixed provider hosts, owner-requested); no other runtime fetch exception. ADR-077 records only explicit static bundled catalog/flag provenance URL literals; choosing sites changes an unsaved local plan and adds no runtime network exception. ADR-078 adds explicit offline external catalogue collector endpoints and dated static catalogue URL data; no extension network exception. ADR-070 (UI only) additionally lists the one static GitHub Releases address of the optional Windows companion in proxy-shared.js: the Proxy tab shows it as a plain link that the person opens in a new tab, and the extension itself never requests it.

apps/production-extension/site-favicon.j.decision: ADR-035; explicit user request for the visited site favicon. Independent source review recorded. Native top-document identity, consent/scope, bounded isolated PNG rasterization and local cache only. Source drift or any additional capability requires a fresh review.

apps/production-extension/precursor-mode.decision: ADR-076; explicit owner request. Independently reviewed fixed GET api.cloudflare.com zone verification/Precursor v1.0, trusted browser-session memory vault, persistent bounded backoff and clock reset recovery, bounded transport and notifications, no redirects or page URL upload. Independent review recorded; final source hash pinned. Any source change requires review.

apps/production-extension/proxy-geo-clie.decision: ADR-109; explicit owner request. One GET per call to the six fixed hosts of the four geolocation providers (the CSP list), credentials omit, redirect error, no referrer, 12 s deadline, 64 KiB streamed body cap, no URL or key in any result; builds and parses nothing itself (proxy-geo-providers.js). Any source change requires review.

apps/production-extension/api-custom-doc.decision: ADR-049; reviewed observer wrapper forwards an existing native setter exactly once and scans resulting frames; it does not construct, coerce or write HTML. The exception applies only to this exact source hash, literal line and html-injection rule.
